property.name: thresholdAmount
property.description: Order value (cents, after discounts) that unlocks free shipping.

property.name: remainingAmount
property.description: Amount (cents) still missing to reach the threshold. 0 when reached.

property.name: isReached
property.description: True when the cart value reaches the threshold.

property.name: freeShippingHint
property.description: Free shipping progress, set by FreeShippingHintCalculatorPlugin.
